text:
Nina: Quick huddle  Vega pilot wants hard launch in 3 weeks. They require tenant-level key wrapping, 100QPS short burst, and deterministic p95 for small prompts. Need owners, absolute blockers, and a minimal acceptance checklist.

Owen: Runtime: hot-pool + KV-reservoir required. Can do burst to 100QPS for ~60s if we reserve hot slots. Blockers: model-swap API and a fast fallback to hosted models. Perf window: 7 business days.

Hana: Infra: can reserve GPUs (floor=3xA100 or 6xA10s) and carve a dedicated subnet. Need SKU confirmation by Tue to secure capacity. Also need peering and static egress IPs for Vega whitelist.

Rex: Security: key-wrapping via HSM is non-negotiable. Blocker until attestation + rotation policy signed off. Shadow mode allowed for perf tests but no live keys. Also need tenant RBAC mapping.

Bea: SRE: propose SLOs: p95 < 150ms, error_rate < 0.5%. Canary ramp: 10% -> 40% -> 100% over 4 days with immediate rollback on alerts. Need oncall for first 48h. Also request synthetic traffic script to validate burst.

Ibrahim: Finance: extra GPUs + HSM add ~$13k/mo. If Vega signs a 4mo commitment we can subsidize ~50% of incremental infra. Product to lead commercial ask.

Owen: Minimal acceptance checklist idea:
```
- infra_reserved: true
- hsm_attestation: green (shadow allowed pre-attestation)
- perf_p95 <= 150ms at 10% canary
- fallback_route_validated (hosted fallback)
- runbook & oncall assigned
- cost_terms_signed or provisional approval
```

Hana: I'll hold capacity for 48h pending SKU confirmation. If no SKU by Tue, we lose preferred pricing.

Rex: I'll draft the attestation checklist and rotation doc. Need product to prioritize RBAC mapping for tenants.

Bea: Oncall nominations: Alex (runtime), Priya (infra), Bea (sre). I'll send rota.

Nina: Owners: product=Nina, runtime=Owen, infra=Hana, security=Rex, sre=Bea, finance=Ibrahim. Timeline: perf tests start Mon, infra reserve by Tue, attestation window Thurs, canary in 3 weeks if all green.

Vega asks: they prefer 20% initial canary. Negotiation: we'll accept 20% only with 4mo commit. Otherwise 10% shadow-first. Please echo objections now. :eyes: :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Automated note: "Deployment window requested: 2026-04-10 01:00-03:00 UTC. Confirm approvals before scheduling."

Owen: Tech caveat: if they insist on 20% without commitment we can do it but must increase headroom to 5 GPUs and add auto-throttle. Cost +$6k/mo.

Ibrahim: I'll prepare pricing options (10% vs 20% canary) and share by EOD Tue.

Nina: Great. Action items: Hana confirm SKU Tue, Owen post perf plan Mon, Rex publish attestation checklist Wed, Ibrahim price ops Tue EOD, Bea publish runbook Mon. Reconvene async in this thread. Thanks all.
